scripts.dev: concurrently -n FRONTEND,SERVER -c blue,green "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix server run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix server
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix server run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix server test
